snippet.title: Kitty Haven - Official Demo Trailer | Dames 4 Games Spring 2026 Showcase
snippet.description: Check out the Kitty Haven trailer for this upcoming cozy puzzle game. Find the perfect spot for picky little furballs: whether they’re greedy, have sensitive noses, or keep getting into stubborn cat fights, arrange the space to bring back peace. Create your own haven by unlocking items and new residents. Solve puzzles and decorate the ideal sanctuary for your kittens! Kitty Haven is available on PC, and a demo is out now on Steam.
